narrative.overview: BChecker is a laboratory test report you fill in and get stamped. The whole page is one sheet of cool security paper lying on a deep teal desk, with a second sheet turned slightly beneath it. Everything on the sheet is printed in teal-black ink: lettered sections, ruled form boxes, typed entries, a graduated scale, and, once a test has run, a red rubber stamp carrying the verdict.
keyCharacteristics: One paper sheet on a desk, one cast shadow, a second sheet visible beneath.
Ink-on-paper contrast: selected means ink fill with paper text, never a glow.
Two voices only: forms lettering (Barlow Condensed) and typed entries (Courier Prime).
Sections lettered A to G as a real sequence, as on a printed form.
A graduated caliper scale and a red stamp carry the result, not a dashboard meter.

rules.name: The Ink Inversion Rule
rules.body: A selected entry is ink fill with paper-white text. Selection is never expressed with a glow, a tint or a colour change alone.

rules.name: The Stamp Colour Rule
rules.body: Red and amber belong to results (stamp, scale fill, remarks). They are not used for buttons, links or decoration.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Forms lettering for what the report says; typewriter for what was entered.

rules.name: The Legend-Only Rule
rules.body: Tracked uppercase labels exist only as form field legends. Headings are real headings.

rules.name: The Cast Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow has an offset and a blur and is cast onto paper or desk. No glow, no inset, no hard offset, no border-plus-shadow pairing.

rules.name: The Flat Print Rule
rules.body: Anything printed on the sheet is flat ink. Depth is not added to individual boxes.

dos: Do keep every elevated surface to the sheet, the under-sheet and the primary button, each with an offset and blur.
Do express selection as an ink fill with paper-white text.
Do set filled-in values in Courier Prime and everything else in Barlow Condensed.
Do continue the lettered sequence (A to G) when adding a section, with the shared section heading.
Do keep component classes inside @layer components so utilities can override them.
donts: Don't return to the near-black neon-green HUD, corner brackets or a grid backdrop.
Don't add inset shadows, bevels or glows to printed boxes.
Don't use red or amber for chrome, links or decoration.
Don't place a tracked small-caps caption above a heading.
Don't add grain or paper-fibre imitations.
Don't introduce a dark theme without reconsidering the world.
